verdict.line: You lose lane the moment you walk into his E (Mourning Mist) mark with no plan to close distance, and you win the second his W (Dark Procession) wall is on cooldown and you can chain your combo onto him before he resets space.

brief.thesis: Yorick's whole kit is built to control range and disengage, not to duel you in melee - his W wall physically blocks movement and his E shreds armor and slows from 700 range, which is why he holds the solo-kill edge despite the lane being even. Riven has to manufacture the fight: use E (Valor)'s damage block to eat his poke on the way in, then land Q into W before he can wall the fight off. The 52.1% Riven win rate over 399 games says her burst window, once it's online, outpaces anything he can answer with.

theirWindow.what: Mourning Mist slows and cuts your armor at 700 range before you're even in melee, and his Mist Walkers gain move speed chasing the mark. Back off and reset rather than walking the rest of the way into a fight he already started on his terms.

yourWindow.when: His W (Dark Procession) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With no wall to hide behind or cut you off, close with E (Valor) to block his poke, chain into Q (Broken Wings) to close the gap, and finish with W (Ki Burst)'s stun - he has nothing left to disengage with.

start.why: 94.1% pick rate at 52.7% win rate - the sustain and early AD let you win the short trades against his Q heal instead of losing attrition.

boots.why: 64% pick rate at 52.8% win rate - the ability haste shortens Q, W, and E's already-short cooldowns, letting you re-engage before he resets to range with E.

core.why: Leads the highest-winning path (69% over 58 games) - the cooldown refund keeps your combo looping faster than he can rebuild his wall.
Second item in that same path - sustain and damage that lets you keep forcing fights through his poke.
Closes out the 69%-win path - the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his Mourning Mist and empowered Q autos while you finish the combo.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through repeated short trades against his Q-sustain pattern, and the healing conversion matters once you're forcing fights through his E poke.

summoners.why: 96.8% pick rate at 52.8% win rate - Ignite punishes his Q heal directly, and Flash lets you close the gap when he tries to kite with E before you've committed Q.

playing.title: Deny free walker poke
playing.detail: His passive, Shepherd of Souls, periodically summons Mist Walkers that swarm and attack nearby enemies. Don't stand in a spot where they can tag you for free before level 3.

playing.title: Trade before level 3
playing.detail: Apply pressure early while his combo is weaker - use E (Valor) to block the bonus damage from his empowered Q (Last Rites) auto and deny the heal it grants him.

playing.title: Respect the W wall
playing.detail: Dark Procession (W, 600 range) drops a wall that blocks movement on a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown. Don't all-in into a choke point where he can wall off your escape or his own retreat - bait it out first.

playing.title: Chain Q into the stun
playing.detail: Open with Q (Broken Wings, 13s cooldown, 275 range) to close distance, then immediately W (Ki Burst, 260 range) so he's stunned and can't walk out of the follow-up.

playing.title: Hold Wind Slash for the gap
playing.detail: Once R (Blade of the Exile) is up, its Wind Slash is a single ranged attack - save it to punish him if he hides behind his own wall instead of fighting.

playing.title: Play around his Q heal
playing.detail: Last Rites only heals him when he lands the bonus-damage auto in melee himself. Disengage with E (Valor) right after your stun window ends rather than trading past it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the ability text, timings, and the tactical reasoning tying them together are my own read, not scraped data.

stats.opponentTip: Try to gain lane control before reaching level 3 by constantly applying pressure to Yorick. Afterwards, try to get a kill by constantly applying pressure while maintaining Conqueror’s stacks.
